name_zh: 任务数 Top-N 负责人的近期增量
name_en: Top-N owners by task count with recent growth
intent: 先选出任务数最多的 Top-N 负责人，再针对这些负责人统计近期新增任务数与增量占比
caliber: 只统计 data_task 中 deleted = 0 且 owner 非空的任务；Top-N 按历史累计任务数排序；近期区间以 created_at 为口径。
notes: 对应论文 Top skills 结构：一次 Top-N 选择喂给第二轮参数化查询，中间用谓词把选中实体收敛进 IN 列表。

params.name: top_n
params.description: 取任务数最多的前 N 位负责人

top_owners.description: 按历史累计任务数选出 Top-N 负责人
top_owners.sql:
SELECT owner, COUNT(id) AS total_cnt
FROM opendataworks.data_task
WHERE deleted = 0
  AND owner IS NOT NULL
  AND owner <> ''
GROUP BY owner
ORDER BY total_cnt DESC
LIMIT {{ params.top_n }}

recent_by_owner.description: 只针对选中的负责人统计近期新增任务数
recent_by_owner.sql:
SELECT owner, COUNT(id) AS recent_cnt
FROM opendataworks.data_task
WHERE deleted = 0
  AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL {{ params.days }} DAY)
  {{? owner_scope }}
GROUP BY owner

merged.description: 把两轮结果合并，缺失的近期增量按 0 处理
merged.sql:
SELECT t.owner AS owner,
       t.total_cnt AS total_cnt,
       COALESCE(r.recent_cnt, 0) AS recent_cnt,
       CAST(COALESCE(r.recent_cnt, 0) AS REAL) / t.total_cnt AS recent_share
FROM top_owners t
LEFT JOIN recent_by_owner r ON t.owner = r.owner
ORDER BY t.total_cnt DESC
